display_title: The Annex Lights Never Go Outs
description:
"Were you staring at my c*ck because you wanted a taste?"

Yiseo stumbled into the wrong room of the grand annex and froze. There he was-Taegyeom Kwon, in all his naked glory, his enormous manhood staring at her. 

Filthy rich, dangerously handsome, unbearably sexy, and utterly crass, he radiated power and magnetism that made him impossible to resist. Worlds apart, impossible to have, and yet every look and touch pulled her into a love she shouldn't want.
